title: WAMs and VLAs for Robot Learning | Cosmos Labs
summary: NVIDIA’s Cosmos Labs livestream lays out how World Action Models and vision-language-action models play different roles in robot foundation models, with WAMs modeling future observations and actions while VLAs connect perception, language, and control. It centers on Cosmos 3, which treats action as a native modality alongside video, and shows how Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID can imagine future observations while generating robot actions. The session is framed as a practical path for adapting and deploying these models with open Cosmos models, datasets, recipes, evaluation workflows, and serving resources.

extra.full_text: Building capable robot foundation models requires more than one approach. Vision-language-action (VLA) models and World Action Models (WAMs) - each offer different strengths for robot learning, planning, and control. In this livestream, NVIDIA researchers Danfei Xu US Moritz Benno Reuss CH Thomas Tian US will explore what World Action Models work, how they compare with modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, and why many next-generation robot foundation models combine both approaches. You'll also see how NVIDIA Cosmos 3 treats action as a native modality, enabling robots to predict future observations while generating actions. We'll walk through how Cosmos 3 provides an open workflow for post-training, evaluation, and deployment using open models, datasets, recipes, and serving resources. Whether you're building manipulation policies, training robot foundation models, or exploring embodied AI, this livestream provides a practical understanding of where World Action Models fit into the future of robotics. What You'll Learn: - What World Action Models are and how they differ from and complement Vision-Language-Action models - The strengths, limitations, and tradeoffs of WAMs, VLAs, and emerging hybrid approaches - How Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID imagines future observations while generating robot actions - How NVIDIA Cosmos 3 represents action as a native modality alongside video - How to evaluate, post-train, and adapt Cosmos 3 using open models, datasets, recipes, and serving resources Have questions about how to post-train and deploy NVIDIA Cosmos 3? Drop them live — the NVIDIA team will answer them in real time. title: Video Friday: Drones Go Heavy in DARPA Lift Challenge
summary: IEEE Spectrum’s Video Friday highlights DARPA’s Lift Challenge, where unconventional heavy-lift drone designs are being tested in a live competition format with recorded livestreams available. The roundup also points to related robot-AI work, including NASA’s SkyFall Mars helicopters carrying flexible fabric-based ground-penetrating radar antennas to search for frozen water, Generalist’s GEN-1 low-level adaptation gains of 10-20x on internal benchmarks, and SonicFly, which lets one UAV follow another using only the leader’s flight sound.

extra.full_text: Video Friday is your weekly selection of awesome robotics videos, collected by your friends at IEEE Spectrum robotics. We also post a weekly calendar of upcoming robotics events for the next few months. Please send us your events for inclusion. Actuate 2026 : 18–19 August 2026, SAN FRANCISCO IROS 2026 : 27 September–1 October 2026, PITTSBURGH Humanoids Summit Seoul : 22–23 September 2026, SEOUL Enjoy today’s videos! The DARPA Lift Challenge is taking place through this weekend. There are a couple of very brief overview videos from the past couple of days, which are only really interesting because they give you a quick look at some utterly bizarre heavy-lift drone designs. If you like what you see, DARPA has recorded livestreams of the entire event so far. We’ve posted one of those at the end of this section, and if you want to be impressed by some super weird drones, check out this and this . [ DARPA Lift Challenge ] When NASA’s SkyFall helicopters take to the Martian skies, one of their tasks will be to hunt for frozen water—a critical resource for future astronauts—using ground-penetrating radar. For that radar to work, the rotorcraft will carry a flexible, fabric-based antenna that extends below the aircraft without interfering with landings or breaking at touchdown. [ NASA ] Why would you even want a five-fingered humanoid hand when you could have something so much better? [ Flexiv ] We’ve improved how GEN-1 learns to adapt to new actuators and new robots at the lowest level, with up to 10-20x gains on internal benchmarks. This significantly boosts performance on high-precision tasks like disassembling parts from a NIST board. [ Generalist ] This is certainly one of the best looking humanoid robots out there. [ Generative Bionics ] A little on the technical side, but the concept here is important, I think: being able to control an assistive robot through touch. [ Tac-Nav ] We present SonicFly, a passive aeroacoustic perception framework that enables one unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) to estimate and follow another using only the leader’s intrinsic flight sound. [ General Robotics Lab ] Okay but... Get a job? [ ROBOTIS ]

title: 핑거, 피지컬 AI 기업 '미켈로로보틱스' 인수…“AI 종합 기술 기업 도약”
summary: 핑거가 산업용 로봇 지능화 기업 미켈로로보틱스를 160억원에 인수하며 피지컬 AI 시장에 진입한다. 2022년 설립된 미켈로로보틱스의 핵심 인력 3명은 총 60억원을 핑거에 재투자하고 3년간 보호예수에 묶이는 구조라, 단순 지분 인수보다 로봇-AI 역량을 내부화해 종합 AI 기술 기업으로 확장하려는 성격이 강하다.

extra.full_text: 국내 1세대 핀테크 기업 핑거(대표 안인주)가 산업용 로봇 지능화 기업 미켈로로보틱스를 인수하며 '피지컬 AI' 시장에 본격 진출한다.핑거는 미켈로로보틱스를 160억원에 인수하는 계약을 체결했다고 7일 밝혔다. 이번 계약은 미켈로로보틱스 박장준 대표 등이 보유한 구주 50만 주를 사들이는 방식으로 이뤄진다. 박 대표를 비롯한 핵심 인력 3인은 책임 경영을 위해 3자 배정 유상증자를 통해 각 20억원씩 총 60억원을 핑거에 재투자하기로 했다. 3년간 락업(보호예수) 조건이다.미켈로로보틱스는 2022년 설립된 피지컬 AI 전문기업이다.

title: 에이엘로봇, 토크 분야 KOLAS 인정…글로벌 품질 신뢰성 강화
summary: AL.Robot, a specialist in robot force/torque sensors and control technology, has been accredited by Korea’s KOLAS as an official calibration body for torque, under recognition number KC26-458. The accreditation, valid from July 29, 2026 to July 28, 2030, signals that its calibration quality system and technical competence meet ISO/IEC 17025:2017 standards, strengthening trust in the company’s sensor measurements for global robotics customers.

title: 한성시스코-로바이, 범용 로봇 제어 AI 플랫폼 실증·상용화 맞손
summary: Hansung Sysco and Robai signed an MOU to test Robai’s general-purpose robot control AI platform, Robot Academy, in rubber and tire manufacturing environments. title: 미 FCC “중국산 로봇·인버터 제한, 미국 생산 확대와 안보 위한 조치”
summary: The FCC is framing potential limits on Chinese-made robots and power inverters as a push to move critical manufacturing back to the United States while reducing national-security exposure in AI, energy, and other infrastructure-heavy sectors. Brendan Carr said U.S. companies should use the moment to invest domestically and build key equipment themselves, signaling a broader effort to localize supply chains and cut dependence on Chinese hardware.

extra.full_text: 미국 연방통신위원회(FCC)가 중국산 로봇과 전력 인버터 등의 수입을 제한하는 것은 미국 내 생산을 신속하게 확대하고 국가안보 위험을 사전에 차단하기 위한 조치라고 밝혔다. 미국이 AI와 에너지 인프라를 비롯한 핵심 산업에서 중국산 장비에 대한 의존도를 낮추고 공급망의 자국화를 가속하는 움직임으로 풀이된다.로이터에 따르면, 브렌던 카 FCC 위원장은 6일(현지시간) 중국산 로봇과 전력 인버터에 대한 제한 조치와 관련해 미국 기업들이 지금이 투자를 국내로 가져오고 국가안보에 중요한 핵심 장비를 자체 개발할 시점이라고 강조했다.그는 앞

title: 한국로봇융합연구원, '2026 제16회 부산로봇경진대회' 8~9일 개최
summary: KIRO is hosting the 16th Busan Robot Competition on August 8-9, 2026, across BEXCO’s second exhibition hall and Tongmyong University’s Marine Robot Hall, with 503 students from 260 teams in Busan, Ulsan, and Gyeongnam. title: 아마존, 영국서 ‘AI 자율 물류’ 현실화…MK30 드론, 12km 반경 배송 상용화
summary: Amazon has begun operating Prime Air drone delivery from its Darlington fulfillment center in England, extending the service beyond the U.S. to real customers in the UK. The system centers on the MK30 drone and ties together AI-based spatial analysis, autonomous flight, real-time obstacle avoidance, weather-data assessment, and warehouse robotics into a more integrated autonomous logistics pipeline, with deliveries reportedly covering a 12 km radius.

title: Quantum-Inspired Software Shatters Engineering Bottlenecks: BQP and Modovolo Are Rewriting the Aerospace Design Playbook
summary: BQP’s quantum-inspired optimization software is being used by Modovolo to compress aerospace drone design cycles that normally require slow physical iteration. The reported result is faster movement from design exploration to scalable hardware, with Modovolo claiming state-of-the-art drone performance, though the provided text does not give specific benchmarks or technical details on the optimization method.

title: 서울시립대 기계정보공학과, CJ대한통운 미래기술챌린지 대상 수상
summary: 서울시립대 기계정보공학과 로보틱스 연구실의 UOS-RoboStack 팀이 CJ대한통운 제6회 미래기술챌린지에서 물류 현장 문제를 겨루는 로봇·AI·빅데이터 기술 아이디어로 대상을 받았다. 같은 연구실의 UOS-CCTV 팀도 3위에 올라, 황면중 교수 연구실이 물류 자동화와 현장 지능화 쪽에서 복수의 경쟁력 있는 아이디어를 냈다는 점이 눈에 띈다.
